options.content: Demo/POC. No data is not healthy. Traces are sampled; ItemCount estimates are not complete traces. Ingestion is delayed. 30-day retention / 1 GB daily emergency cap (overshoot billed). Stop cannot remove ingested content or control provider-managed Foundry tracing. Daily message balance/token quota/invoice cost are unavailable. Native resource metrics are in the admin snapshot/workbook resource links. No dedicated Grafana instance or Prometheus workspace.

azureLogAnalytics.query: AppRequests | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and isnotempty(Url) and isempty(tostring(Properties['messaging.operation.type'])) | summarize observed=count(),estimated=sum(ItemCount),failed=countif(Success == false),p95Ms=percentile(DurationMs,95),lastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by AppRoleName | take 30

AppDependencies | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and tostring(Properties['gen_ai.operation.name']) != '' | summarize observedSpans=count(),failed=countif(Success == false),p95Ms=percentile(DurationMs,95) by AppRoleName,operation=tostring(Properties['gen_ai.operation.name']),model=tostring(Properties['gen_ai.request.model']) | take 50

union (AppEvents | where Name startswith 'Workflow.' or Name startswith 'BackgroundWork.'),(AppRequests | where tostring(Properties['messaging.operation.type']) == 'process'),(AppDependencies | where tostring(Properties['messaging.operation.type']) == 'process') | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | summarize observed=count(),lastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by AppRoleName,Name,outcome=tostring(Properties['outcome']) | take 50

panels.title: Browser Web Vitals and logical outcomes

azureLogAnalytics.query: AppEvents | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and Name startswith 'browser.' | summarize observed=count(),p75=percentile(todouble(Properties['value']),75),lastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by AppRoleName,Name,metric=tostring(Properties['metric']),availability=tostring(Properties['availability']),outcome=tostring(Properties['outcome']) | take 50

panels.title: Ingestion volume and last seen (not invoice totals)

azureLogAnalytics.query: union withsource=tableName AppRequests,AppDependencies,AppEvents,AppTraces,AppExceptions,AppMetrics,AppPageViews | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | summarize billableBytes=sumif(_BilledSize,_IsBillable == 'true'),lastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),observed=count() by tableName,AppRoleName | take 50

panels.title: Safe recent transaction IDs and parent links

azureLogAnalytics.query: AppDependencies | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | project TimeGenerated,AppRoleName,OperationId,Id,ParentId,Type,DurationMs,Success | top 100 by TimeGenerated desc
AppDependencies | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) | summarize observed=count(),failed=countif(Success == false),p95Ms=percentile(DurationMs,95) by AppRoleName,Type | take 50
